before.PARTIAL: Ready count below2 or ready/target cap truncates, or busy estimate exhausted, or bounded model cannot cover target. Record COVERAGE_INSUFFICIENT; optional bounded partial projection is descriptive only, never enter hit/rate denominator or be imputed zero.
before.INVALID: Malformed/nonfinite public state, illegal predecessor/compatibility identity, missing refs, impossible ordering/calendars or independent mismatch. Stop plan; not a negative opportunity.
before.MISSING: Missing required snapshot/stream/record is INCOMPLETE, not PARTIAL coverage.

after.scope: All16 K assignments zero; one suffix mapping improves. Not a claim of B2 reachability or calibration frequency.

before.use: Historical definition only, not the v2 stage observer; cannot infer absence of remaining-H-path mechanism from its negative result.

exact_changes.before: Use snapshot+observer spec only; verify fixed target/action/order, baseline membership, all Cartesian assignments and L caps, projection intervals, exact objective/ties/gain, coverage and representative event. No source-private true fields.

after.observation_boundary: Only exact PUBLIC_SNAPSHOT; no future arrivals/private durations/queue/truth; all predictions are offline and cannot change scheduler/actual B2 trace.

scope.eligible: At least one dependency-ready not-started node anywhere among arrived services AND at least one arrived H service with a not-started node; H running prefix with an unready H descendant qualifies.
scope.action_nodes: First min(4,all_dependency_ready_count) in unchanged B2 (H first, absolute deadline, service_id,node_id) order when at least2 ready nodes exist. With exactly1 ready node record COVERAGE_INSUFFICIENT/READY_COUNT_BELOW_TWO and do not enumerate, preserving the original2-4-ready oracle scope.
scope.target_H_services: First min(2,number of unfinished arrived H services with >=1 not-started node), ordered absolute deadline then service_id; fixed before any gain calculation.
scope.suffix: All still-unplaced nodes of the selected target H services, including public unready descendants; each approved graph has at most16 nodes. Completed/running/current-action target nodes treated as already fixed/forecast placed.
scope.visible_running: At most6 units. release_hat=now+max(0,estimate-elapsed). If any busy unit has elapsed>=estimate, future release cannot be placed from public info: mark COVERAGE_INSUFFICIENT, do not invent epsilon or consult true completion.
scope.unselected_work: No unselected ready node, unselected H target, L successor or future arrival is projected; report exclusions and truncation. Never interpret result as global optimality.

projection.arithmetic: Exact Rational values decoded from public binary64 bits. All forecast communication L+b/B and interval algebra use those rationals, not hidden truths. This surrogate need not bit-match runtime floating prediction.
projection.initial_calendar: For each busy unit reserve forecast[now,release_hat); idle units have no forecast busy interval. Public completed outputs remain fixed at actual known finish/resource.
projection.current_actions: Place K in fixed B2 order. For each assignment, earliest entire idle gap at/after now, service arrival and all completed predecessor copies, using projected running calendars. No preemption/migration/overlap. All chosen action intervals remain fixed for suffix rollout.
projection.baseline: Greedy minimum predicted EFT with resource-ID ties for each K action using the same placement arithmetic/calendar; not a claim to reproduce actual future B2 execution.
projection.suffix_order: Static Kahn placement of selected target pending nodes after treating completed/running/K as placed; among available nodes choose (service absolute deadline,service_id,node_id). Same order in baseline and every assignment; no suffix search.
projection.suffix_mapping: For each suffix node, choose minimum predicted EFT/resource ID among compatible units using earliest entire idle-gap insertion. Parents may have fixed known or projected finishes; projected finish is never an actual completed fact.
projection.objective: Minimize arithmetic mean of projected completion times of the fixed selected H services; completion=max projected/known finish over all nodes of each target service. No deadline/miss or true-duration objective substitution.
projection.L_constraint: For every L node in K: candidate predicted finish <= max(baseline predicted finish, its service absolute deadline). No claim about full-L-service completion or global L-P95 budget. This is a new diagnostic slack rule, not the registered1.10 threshold.
projection.admissible: Enumerate complete Cartesian product of compatible resources for K, <=6^4. No task-order branching, no optimization of suffix mappings, no future tasks. Baseline is included and satisfies its own L cap.
projection.ties: Compare H objective exactly; equal objectives choose lexicographic resource-ID tuple in K order. Suffix/greedy resource ties use fixed resource ID order.
projection.gain: b=baseline target-H mean finish-now>0; o=best corresponding finish-now; delta=b-o>=0 ms, g=delta/b dimensionless. Persist exact rationals, no arbitrary epsilon.

coverage.FULL: All ready actions fit2<=K<=4; all candidate pending H services fit<=2; complete approved target DAGs; all running releases predictable from estimates; all enumeration/projection records complete.
coverage.PARTIAL: Ready count below2 or ready/target cap truncates, or busy estimate exhausted, or bounded model cannot cover target. Record COVERAGE_INSUFFICIENT; optional bounded partial projection is descriptive only, never enter hit/rate denominator or be imputed zero.
coverage.INVALID: Malformed/nonfinite public state, illegal predecessor/compatibility identity, missing refs, impossible ordering/calendars or independent mismatch. Stop plan; not a negative opportunity.
coverage.MISSING: Missing required snapshot/stream/record is INCOMPLETE, not PARTIAL coverage.

stage_denominators.F: subset of E with VALID_FULL complete diagnostic
stage_denominators.hits: subset of F with g>=preapproved tau
stage_denominators.p: hits/F only when F>0; partial states not zero or hits
stage_denominators.zero: E=0 or F=0 => insufficient evidence; p=null, never0
